data.name: Spellcasting (1 PP)
data.description: You can have any of the following spells cast for you (the CL in each case is the minimum possible for the spell): cure moderate wounds, dispel magic, lesser restoration, make whole, remove blindness/deafness, remove curse, remove disease, remove paralysis.
